resources.string: Where new wallpapers come from: pictures from the internet and repositories of packages. Nothing is downloaded until you turn something on.
A picture source brings new pictures by itself: the picture of the day, a search or your own server. Each one is off until you turn it on, and each one tells you whom it contacts.
Automatic downloads wait for Wi-Fi and a battery that is not low. You can change this in Settings.
Automatic downloads may use mobile data, but still wait for a battery that is not low. You can change this in Settings.
Last checked %1$s. Pictures in your library from this source: %2$d
Remove this picture source? Pictures it already brought stay in your library unless you tick the box.
Also remove the pictures it brought
A key or password is already stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
The latest daily pictures from Bing, in high resolution.
The astronomy picture of the day from NASA. Videos are skipped.
The featured picture of the day from Wikimedia Commons.
Pictures found by a search on Wallhaven. Only safe-for-work pictures are asked for.
Pictures from a folder on a WebDAV server you run or rent.
Pictures from a folder of your Nextcloud.
Pictures from an album of your Immich server.
Turning it on contacts %1$s. That site sees this phone\'s internet address and the language and country you choose. Nothing else is sent.
Turning it on contacts %1$s. Those sites see this phone\'s internet address and, if you enter one, your NASA key. Nothing else is sent.
Turning it on contacts %1$s. Those sites see this phone\'s internet address. Nothing else is sent.
Turning it on contacts %1$s. That site sees this phone\'s internet address, your search words and, if you enter one, your key. Nothing else is sent.
Turning it on contacts %1$s. That server sees this phone\'s internet address, your user name and your password. Use only a server you trust.
Turning it on contacts %1$s. That server sees this phone\'s internet address, the album you name and your key. Use only a server you trust.
Language and country, for example en-US
How many pictures to look at (1 to 8)
How many past days to include (1 to 30)
Search words (empty for the most popular)
Most pictures to look at (1 to 24)
Pictures to keep from this source (5 to 200)
You have not added any repository yet. A repository is a catalog of wallpaper packages kept by someone you trust.
Nothing to show. Try other search words, or refresh the repositories.

Ask the person who publishes the repository for two things: its address and its fingerprint. The fingerprint is a long code that names the repository\'s signing key. The phone only accepts the repository if it answers with exactly that key, so nobody in between can swap the packages.
Spaces are fine. Leave it empty only if the address already ends with ?fingerprint=…
Adding it contacts %1$s and reads its list of packages. That site sees this phone\'s internet address.
